description: A deadly virus spread to people from the saliva of infected animals.
prevention: Vaccinate pets and avoid wild animals.
treatment_action: Immediate post-exposure prophylaxis (vaccine and immune globulin).
complications: Death is almost certain once symptoms appear.

description: A chronic inflammatory disorder that can affect more than just your joints.
symptoms: Fatigue, fever and loss of appetite
treatment_action: Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) and physical therapy.
complications: Osteoporosis, rheumatoid nodules, and heart problems.
